frictions.description: Database was not empty when testing started — another concurrent subagent (group-b) had already created and modified an entry (id=1 with EditTestUser/TestCorpGroupB). VAL-TIME-001 was tested first and caught the empty state before other group's modifications, but subsequent tests had to account for shared DB state.
frictions.resolution: Tested VAL-TIME-001 first as instructed. Used unique prefixes (GroupA*) for data created by this group to distinguish from other groups. The other group's entry was later deleted by that group, so final list only shows this group's entries.

summary: Tested 7 assertions: all 7 passed. Empty state, create form, required field validation, hours boundary validation, input preservation, successful creation with PRG redirect, and list display all working correctly.
